trello.name: Implement worker queue depth alerting
trello.desc: Add monitoring and alerting for job queue depth across the entire worker fleet, not just payment workers. Create a warning alert at 1,000 jobs and a page alert at 5,000 jobs with the same thresholds for all workers. Kofi owns. Acceptance criteria: alerts fire in staging and production, alert definitions are documented, and no blind period like the 16 minutes from 14:03 to 14:19 in the outage remains.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry storm and dead-letter handling
trello.desc: Update payment_worker.py _process_with_retry function. Replace immediate 5x back-to-back retries with exponential backoff with jitter and a capped retry count. Change failure handling so jobs are not re-enqueued at the front of the main queue; instead send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back. Marta owns. Add unit/integration tests that simulate card processor 503 responses to verify backoff, jitter, cap, and dead-letter routing. Acceptance criteria: retry storm cannot re-create the queue spike observed on Tuesday, failed jobs land in DLQ, tests pass.

trello.name: Isolate and increase DB connection pools
trello.desc: Address worker and API coupling via DB connections. In the shared config file, increase the pool size from default 20 to 100 as an interim mitigation, and split worker and API pools so they no longer share connections. Kofi owns both parts in one change. Acceptance criteria: worker pool and API pool are separate, pool size is 100, load tests show API remains available under worker pile-up.

trello.name: Refresh payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Update the payment incident runbook owned by Priya. Replace references to old Kibana, decommissioned in March, with current logging links. Document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised on Tuesday as a formal step. Verify escalation phone numbers are current and remove stale contacts, e.g., the number still routing to an employee who left last year. Acceptance criteria: runbook links resolve, queue drain procedure is step-by-step, escalation contacts are verified and accurate.

trello.name: Automate status page on checkout error rate
trello.desc: Reduce manual status page latency. Use the status provider API to automatically set status to 'investigating' with a template message when the checkout error rate alert fires. Marta owns initial wiring to the checkout alert; extension to other alerts can follow later. Acceptance criteria: simulated checkout error rate alert triggers automatic status page update within seconds, no manual login required.

trello.name: Plan payment processor failover game day
trello.desc: Validate secondary payment processor failover which is configured but never exercised. Kofi leads creation of a controlled chaos test plan for staging first, then production during a low-traffic window with a rollback plan. Draft plan only for now; plan must be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until review is complete. Acceptance criteria: written game day plan with objectives, staging steps, production window, rollback criteria, and review sign-off.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Remediate infra debt: Redis 6.0 is EOL since June with no security fixes. Upgrade to 7.2. Account for config rename and changed persistence defaults. Schedule via infra calendar with a proper change window, not a casual Friday deploy. Kofi owns scheduling and execution. Acceptance criteria: Redis cluster running 7.2, config migrated, persistence behavior validated, security scan passes.
